description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing notes in a frontend application. It includes state variables for notes, loading status, error messages, and query string. It also provides methods to set the query, load notes from an API, add, edit, and remove notes.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query and triggers loading of notes based on the new query.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API based on the current query and updates the store's state.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new note via the API and adds it to the store.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Updates an existing note via the API and reflects the change in the store.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a note through the API and removes it from the store.
